description: Reference policy demonstrating capability-based authorization for Connector SDK connectors. Outcomes are strictly approve (ALLOW) or reject (BLOCK) — there is no approval-workflow, pending, or human-approval outcome.

unboundSignalReasons.capability: The Intent snapshot boundSignals binds against exposes only { target, parameters } (see SignalIntentBinder), not the executed action itself, so the capability selector has no dot-path to bind to -- it is independently enforced by capability-registry's CANONICAL_CAPABILITY_POLICY_BINDINGS / assertConnectorCapabilitiesBound instead.

outcome.reason: ALLOW: crm:read is authorized read-only CRM access.
ALLOW: payments:refund is authorized because the requested amount does not exceed the configured refund threshold of 5000.
BLOCK: crm:delete is never authorized by this reference policy.
BLOCK: payments:refund is rejected because the requested amount exceeds the configured refund threshold of 5000.
BLOCK: capability is not explicitly authorized by this reference policy.
